caption: What to do if you're holding on to past anger #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #selflove #parenting
transcript: You are still angry at your parents for something in the past. Should you confront them or should you let it rest? My friend, everyone will tell you to bring it up. Say what you never said. Make them answer for it. But listen carefully. Anger that old is not asking for a conversation. It is asking for something they may never be able to give you. An apology that undoes what already happened. Ask yourself this first. Do you want them to understand or do you want the past to change? Because one of those is possible. And one of those will never happen, no matter what they say. Think of a wound from long ago. The skin closes but the scar stays. You do not owe the scar your whole life. But pretending it isn't there does not heal it either. So speak if speaking brings you peace. Stay quiet if quiet brings you peace. But do not carry the wound and call it loyalty. You are allowed to love them and still grieve what they could not give you. Because forgiveness is not saying it was fine. It is deciding the weight of it no longer gets to decide your days.
